priorityList: Use all offensive cooldowns (Racials, Potions, and Trinkets) when Bestial Wrath is active.
Cast Barbed Shot if Bestial Wrath is about to come off cooldown (less than 1 GCD remaining).
Cast Kill Command if Nature's Ally (Sentinel Owl) is active or ready to be summoned, unless Bestial Wrath is coming back very soon.
Cast Kill Command if you have an Apex Predator proc to prevent capping.
Cast Barbed Shot to maintain 3 stacks of Frenzy on your pet.
Cast Barbed Shot to avoid capping at 2 charges.
Cast Cobra Shot as a filler when Kill Command is on cooldown and you have excess Focus.
